test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In March 2022, which state government launched a new Sports policy 2022-27?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Restructure sports governance:** Streamline decision-making and enhance accountability within sports bodies.
 
• **Foster a sports culture:** Promote sports participation at all levels, from grassroots to elite.
 
• **Develop grassroots sports:** Focus on identifying and nurturing young talent in underserved areas.
 
• **Prepare for international success:** Provide world-class training and support to elite athletes.
 
• **Promote sports tourism:** Attract international sports events and leverage sports for economic benefits.
